transport.go_start.title: Return to start
transport.go_start.text: Moves the playhead to the beginning of the song.

transport.stop.title: Stop
transport.stop.text: Stops playback or recording. Where the playhead ends up follows the Return to start on stop preference of the Workflow settings.

transport.play.title: Play
transport.play.text: Starts the song from the playhead. While the song is playing the same button stops it. The lit button means the song is running.

transport.record.title: Record
transport.record.text: Records into the armed tracks: notes and audio you play, and the parameters you move when automation recording is on. Everything you record is one undo step.

transport.auto_lanes.title: Auto-create lanes
transport.auto_lanes.text: While it is lit, a take also records every parameter you move and adds an automation lane for it, so you do not have to make the lanes first.

transport.loop.title: Loop
transport.loop.text: Plays the range between the left and right locators over and over. Set the range with the locators.

transport.metronome.title: Metronome
transport.metronome.text: Plays a click on every beat while the song plays or records. The click level is set with the Click level control.

transport.override.title: Overridden lanes
transport.override.text: Some automation lanes hold a value you moved by hand while the song plays. Click to let all of them play their automation again.

transport.tempo.title: Tempo
transport.tempo.text: The speed of the song in beats per minute. Drag or scroll the number to change it, hold Shift for fine steps, or double-click to type a value. Tempo changes along the song are drawn in the tempo lane.

transport.meter.title: Time signature
transport.meter.text: How many beats a bar has and which note value is a beat. Drag or scroll either number, or double-click to type.

transport.rewind.title: Rewind
transport.rewind.text: Moves the playhead back by bars. Hold the button to repeat; the longer you hold it, the faster it goes.

transport.forward.title: Fast forward
transport.forward.text: Moves the playhead forward by bars. Hold the button to repeat; the longer you hold it, the faster it goes.

transport.tap_tempo.title: Tap tempo
transport.tap_tempo.text: Tap the beat on this button. The average of your last taps sets the tempo of the song.

transport.go_left.title: Go to the left locator
transport.go_left.text: Moves the playhead to the left end of the loop range.

transport.go_right.title: Go to the right locator
transport.go_right.text: Moves the playhead to the right end of the loop range.

transport.left_locator.title: Left locator
transport.left_locator.text: The start of the loop range, written as bar, beat and tick. Double-click to type a new position.

transport.right_locator.title: Right locator
transport.right_locator.text: The end of the loop range, written as bar, beat and tick. Double-click to type a new position.

transport.click_level.title: Click level
transport.click_level.text: How loud the metronome is. Drag or scroll to change it, or double-click to go back to the default.

transport.q_rec.title: Q Rec
transport.q_rec.text: Quantizes the notes you record: each note snaps to the grid next to this button as it is played in. Off keeps your timing exactly.

transport.q_rec_grid.title: Q Rec grid
transport.q_rec_grid.text: The grid the recorded notes snap to when Q Rec is on. Click, drag or scroll to change it.

transport.quantize.title: Quantize
transport.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected clips or notes with the last settings of the quantize panel, so you can repeat the same quantize with one click.

transport.song_key.title: Song key
transport.song_key.text: The key of the song at the playhead. Click to set it; the piano roll, the browser and the chord tools follow it.

transport.camera.title: Camera
transport.camera.text: Turns the webcam control on or off. Click a knob, pinch your thumb and index finger and twist your wrist to turn it. The first time it asks before it downloads the hand models. The camera picture stays in memory and is never saved or sent.

transport.more.title: More transport controls
transport.more.text: The bar has no room for every control in a narrow window. This menu holds the ones that did not fit.

arrangement.track_mute.title: Mute track
arrangement.track_mute.text: Silences this track. A muted track keeps its clips and its place in the mix.

arrangement.track_solo.title: Solo track
arrangement.track_solo.text: Plays only this track and the other soloed tracks. Click again to bring the rest of the song back.

arrangement.track_arm.title: Arm for recording
arrangement.track_arm.text: Arms the track: the next recording writes the notes or audio you play into it. More than one track can be armed.

arrangement.track_expand.title: Show lanes
arrangement.track_expand.text: Shows or hides the automation lanes of this track under its clips.

arrangement.add_lane.title: Add a lane
arrangement.add_lane.text: Adds an automation lane for a parameter of the track's device, chosen from a list. The lane draws how the parameter moves over the song.

arrangement.track_input.title: Audio input
arrangement.track_input.text: The audio input this track records from. Click to choose one of the inputs of the audio interface.

arrangement.track_monitor.title: Input monitoring
arrangement.track_monitor.text: Whether you hear the input while you record. Click to step through off, auto (while recording or stopped) and always on.

arrangement.track_controllers.title: Controller lanes
arrangement.track_controllers.text: This track holds controller lanes of its own, such as mod wheel or pedal. Click to edit them in the piano roll.

arrangement.track_keys.title: Master keyboard
arrangement.track_keys.text: The arrow marks the track that your MIDI keyboard plays. In the separated keyboard mode, click it to choose another track.

arrangement.lane_mute.title: Mute lane
arrangement.lane_mute.text: Silences this lane. A muted automation lane leaves its parameter at the value it holds.

arrangement.lane_solo.title: Solo lane
arrangement.lane_solo.text: While a lane is soloed, only the soloed lanes of the track play.

arrangement.lane_delete.title: Delete lane
arrangement.lane_delete.text: Removes this automation lane and all the clips and points on it. You can undo it.

arrangement.lane_fold.title: Fold lane
arrangement.lane_fold.text: Shrinks the lane to a thin strip to save room, or opens it again.

arrangement.lane_arm.title: Arm lane
arrangement.lane_arm.text: Arms this automation lane: moving its parameter while recording writes the movement into the lane.

arrangement.lane_mode.title: Write mode
arrangement.lane_mode.text: How automation recording writes. Overwrite replaces the lane while it records, touch writes only while you hold a control, latch keeps writing after you let go.

arrangement.clear_mutes.title: Clear all mutes
arrangement.clear_mutes.text: Un-mutes every track and lane at once.

arrangement.clear_solos.title: Clear all solos
arrangement.clear_solos.text: Turns every solo off at once, so the whole song plays again.

arrangement.quantize.title: Quantize
arrangement.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected clips with the last settings of the quantize panel. Right-click to open the panel.

arrangement.manual_rec.title: Manual Rec
arrangement.manual_rec.text: When it is on, selecting a track no longer arms it. Arm tracks yourself with their R buttons.

arrangement.snap.title: Snap grid
arrangement.snap.text: The grid that clips and points snap to while you draw and move them. Click to step to the next value, or drag or scroll to choose.

arrangement.tool_select.title: Select tool
arrangement.tool_select.text: The tool for everyday work: click to select, drag to move or resize, and drag on an empty place to box-select.

arrangement.tool_pencil.title: Pencil tool
arrangement.tool_pencil.text: Click on a lane to draw a clip, or an automation point on an automation lane. Drag to draw a longer clip.

arrangement.tool_eraser.title: Eraser tool
arrangement.tool_eraser.text: Click a clip or a point to delete it. Drag across several to delete them all.

arrangement.tool_razor.title: Razor tool
arrangement.tool_razor.text: Click a clip to split it at the snapped position, or click in a take row to cut the comp there.

arrangement.tool_speaker.title: Speaker tool
arrangement.tool_speaker.text: Press on an audio clip to hear it as it is in its file, release to stop. It does not move the playhead.

arrangement.tool_mute.title: Mute tool
arrangement.tool_mute.text: Click a clip to mute or unmute it. A muted clip stays where it is and plays silently.

arrangement.tool_magnifier.title: Magnifier tool
arrangement.tool_magnifier.text: Click to zoom in, Shift-click to zoom out, or drag a rectangle to zoom to it.

arrangement.tool_hand.title: Hand tool
arrangement.tool_hand.text: Drag to scroll the view in any direction.

console.fold_all.title: Fold sections
console.fold_all.text: Folds every section of every strip to its header, or unfolds them all again.

console.add_channel.title: Add channel
console.add_channel.text: Adds an empty mix channel, or a channel for an instrument that has none yet.

console.compensation.title: Delay compensation
console.compensation.text: Lines the strips up by their latency, so a plugin that delays its sound does not make that track late.

console.arrange.title: Back to the arrangement
console.arrange.text: Closes the mixer and shows the arrangement again.

console.maximise.title: Maximise the mixer
console.maximise.text: Gives the mixer the whole window, or brings the rack and the arrangement back.

console.clear_solos.title: Clear all solos
console.clear_solos.text: Turns every solo off at once.

console.mono.title: Mono listening
console.mono.text: Folds what you hear to mono, (L + R) / 2 on both sides, to check that the mix holds up. Lit while it is on. It only changes what you hear: never saved in the project, never in a bounce or an export.

console.store_snapshot.title: Store a snapshot
console.store_snapshot.text: Stores the whole mix as a snapshot chip. Click the chip later to recall that mix.

console.compare.title: Compare
console.compare.text: Flips between the live mix and the snapshot, so you can hear what changed.

console.end_compare.title: End compare
console.end_compare.text: Ends the comparison and keeps the live mix as it is.

console.section.title: Strip section
console.section.text: The header of a section of the strips, such as EQ or sends. Click to fold or unfold that section on every strip.

console.output.title: Output
console.output.text: Where this strip's sound goes: the master, a bus or another channel. Click to choose.

console.insert.title: Insert slot
console.insert.text: An effect that sits in the strip's signal path, before the fader. Click to select it or to add one, and drag to change the order.

console.snapshot.title: Snapshot
console.snapshot.text: A stored mix. Click to recall it, double-click to rename it, and right-click for more.

console.group.title: Group
console.group.text: A group moves several strips with one fader. The plate selects the members; right-click it for more.

browser.recursive.title: Include sub-folders
browser.recursive.text: Lists the files of the folder and of every folder inside it in one list.

browser.preview_level.title: Preview level
browser.preview_level.text: How loud the browser plays a file when you preview it. Drag to set it, double-click to go back to 0 dB.

browser.preview.title: Preview
browser.preview.text: When it is on, selecting an audio file plays it so you can hear it before you use it.

browser.sort.title: Sort
browser.sort.text: Sorts the list by this column. Click the same column again to reverse the order.

browser.back.title: Back
browser.back.text: Goes back to the place you looked at before.

browser.forward.title: Forward
browser.forward.text: Goes forward again after going back.

browser.path.title: Path
browser.path.text: The folder you are in. Click any part of the path to go to that folder.

roll.snap.title: Snap grid
roll.snap.text: The grid that notes snap to while you draw and move them. Click to step to the next value, or drag or scroll to choose.

roll.quantize.title: Quantize
roll.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected notes with the last settings of the quantize panel.

roll.quantize_options.title: Quantize options
roll.quantize_options.text: Opens the quantize panel: the grid, the strength, swing, groove and what else the quantize changes.

roll.close.title: Close the piano roll
roll.close.text: Closes the piano roll and shows the arrangement again.

roll.tool_select.title: Select tool
roll.tool_select.text: Click to select notes, drag to move or resize them, and drag on an empty place to box-select.

roll.tool_pencil.title: Pencil tool
roll.tool_pencil.text: Click to draw a note at the snapped position. Drag to draw a longer one.

roll.tool_eraser.title: Eraser tool
roll.tool_eraser.text: Click a note to delete it. Drag across several to delete them all.

roll.tool_razor.title: Razor tool
roll.tool_razor.text: Click a note to split it in two at the snapped position.

roll.tool_other.title: Tool of the arrangement
roll.tool_other.text: This tool works in the arrangement. The piano roll offers the select, pencil, eraser and razor tools.

roll.scale_root.title: Scale root
roll.scale_root.text: The note the scale starts on. Click to choose it.

roll.scale_kind.title: Scale
roll.scale_kind.text: The kind of scale, such as major or minor. Click to choose it.

roll.scale_detect.title: Detect the scale
roll.scale_detect.text: Looks at the notes of the clip and picks the scale that fits them best.

roll.scale_snap.title: Snap to scale
roll.scale_snap.text: When it is on, notes you draw or move jump to the nearest note of the scale.

roll.fold_keys.title: Fold keys
roll.fold_keys.text: Hides the keys that are outside the scale or not used by any note, so the notes that matter get more room.

roll.chord.title: Chord stamp
roll.chord.text: With the pencil, a click drops a whole chord instead of one note. Click to choose which chord.

roll.inversion.title: Chord inversion
roll.inversion.text: Turns the stamped chord upside down. Click for the next inversion, right-click for the previous.

roll.controllers.title: Controller lanes
roll.controllers.text: Shows or hides the controller lanes (mod wheel, pedal, pitch bend) under the velocity lane.

roll.expr_tab.title: Expression curve
roll.expr_tab.text: Picks which curve of the note you edit: pitch (in semitones), pressure or timbre. A tab name in bright text means that curve has points.

roll.expr_range.title: Pitch scale
roll.expr_range.text: How many semitones the pitch plot shows above and below its middle: 48, 24, 12 or 2. Click for the next, right-click for the last. A smaller scale makes small bends easier to draw.

roll.expr_apply.title: Apply curve
roll.expr_apply.text: Copies this curve of the first selected note to the other selected notes, stretched to the length of each. One undo step.

roll.expr_clear.title: Clear expression
roll.expr_clear.text: Removes the pitch, pressure and timbre curves of this note. One undo step.

roll.expr_curve.title: Expression plot
roll.expr_curve.text: Click to add a point. Drag a point to move it (Shift moves finely, Ctrl snaps a pitch to a semitone). Alt-click or double-click a point to delete it. Drag from empty space to select several points, or with the Pencil tool to draw freehand.

launcher.back.title: Back to arrangement
launcher.back.text: Every track plays its own arrangement again, now. It is lit while any track plays a launcher clip.

launcher.record.title: Record launches
launcher.record.text: When it is on and you record, everything you launch is written into the arrangement as clips at the song position where it really started.

launcher.stop_empty.title: Scene stops empty tracks
launcher.stop_empty.text: When it is on, launching a scene also stops the tracks that play a clip but have none in that scene.

launcher.quantize.title: Launch quantize
launcher.quantize.text: How long a launch waits for the next boundary, from none to four bars. Click for the next value.

launcher.stop_all.title: Stop all clips
launcher.stop_all.text: Stops every playing clip at the next launch boundary.

launcher.stop.title: Stop track
launcher.stop.text: Stops the clip this track plays at the next boundary. The track then plays its arrangement again.

launcher.track.title: Track
launcher.track.text: A column of the grid is a track of the arrangement, in the same order and colour.

launcher.slot_play.title: Launch clip
launcher.slot_play.text: Starts this clip at the next launch boundary. It plays from its own start and loops until you stop it or launch another.

launcher.slot.title: Clip slot
launcher.slot.text: Holds one looping clip. Double-click an empty slot to make a clip, double-click a clip to edit it, drag it to move it, and drag with Ctrl held to copy it.

launcher.scene_launch.title: Launch scene
launcher.scene_launch.text: Launches every clip of this row at once, at the next launch boundary.

launcher.scene.title: Scene
launcher.scene.text: A row of the grid. Double-click its name to rename it, and right-click for the list of scene commands.

rack.name.title: Device name
rack.name.text: The name of the device. Double-click to rename it.

rack.fold.title: Fold device
rack.fold.text: Folds the device to a thin strip to save room in the rack, or unfolds it again.

rack.edit_samples.title: Edit samples
rack.edit_samples.text: Opens the sample editor on this device's samples, to trim, loop and slice them.

rack.to_channel.title: Add a mixer channel
rack.to_channel.text: Adds a console channel for this device and routes its sound into it.

rack.sample.title: Sample
rack.sample.text: Records from the audio input straight into this device. Click again to stop; right-click to choose the input.

rack.slice.title: Slice
rack.slice.text: Cuts the loop into slices at its transients. The knob next to it sets how many slices there are.

rack.slices_to_track.title: Slices to track
rack.slices_to_track.text: Lays the slices out as notes on a new track, in their original order, so the loop plays back as written.

rack.sidechain.title: Sidechain source
rack.sidechain.text: Chooses the signal this effect listens to. The effect reacts to that signal instead of its own input.

rack.resonance_find.title: Find resonances
rack.resonance_find.text: Listens to the range between the locators at this device's input and marks the resonances that stick out.

rack.resonance_cut.title: Cut resonances
rack.resonance_cut.text: Cuts the marked resonances with the free bands. The cuts are dynamic: they act only while the peak sounds.

rack.spectrum_ref.title: Second curve
rack.spectrum_ref.text: Draws another strip or the reference track as a second curve over the spectrum, so the two can be compared. The choice is saved with the device.

rack.spectrum_stats.title: Correlation, peaks and clips
rack.spectrum_stats.text: The stereo correlation (the tick is the 3 s value), the sample peak of each side, the true peak, the headroom under the largest peak and the number of clipped samples since the last reset. Click to reset the peaks and the clips.

rack.tonal_target.title: Target
rack.tonal_target.text: Opens the list of targets the mix is compared with: four built-in ones, the target you just learned, and the ones you saved. It also learns a target from audio files, and saves, renames or deletes one. The choice is saved with the device; the saved targets are kept with your settings.

rack.duck_learn.title: Learn the duck curve
rack.duck_learn.text: Listens to the range between the locators at the key and draws the duck curve from the shape of its hits.

rack.table_edit.title: Table editor
rack.table_edit.text: Opens the table editor: draw frames, set harmonics, morph between frames and clean up a sample.

rack.duck_plot.title: Duck curve
rack.duck_plot.text: Drag a point or the line between two points. Click to add a point, and double-click a point to remove it.

rack.tuner.title: Tuner
rack.tuner.text: Shows or hides the tuner. It reads the input of this track.

rack.preview_player.title: Preview player
rack.preview_player.text: Plays this player and the players after it while the song is stopped. Click again to stop.

rack.container_fold.title: Fold container
rack.container_fold.text: Shows the devices of the container under its panel, or folds them away.

rack.container_open.title: Open container
rack.container_open.text: Shows the devices of the container in a view of their own, one level down.

rack.container_edit.title: Container editor
rack.container_edit.text: Opens the container editor, where you choose the sockets and macro knobs the container shows.

rack.plugin_power.title: Plugin power
rack.plugin_power.text: Switches the plugin on or off. An off plugin uses no CPU and is silent.

rack.plugin_bypass.title: Plugin bypass
rack.plugin_bypass.text: Bypasses the plugin: the dry signal passes through unchanged.

rack.plugin_audio_thread.title: Run on the audio thread
rack.plugin_audio_thread.text: Runs this plugin on the audio thread instead of in its own process. It is faster but a crashing plugin can stop the sound, so it is off by default.

rack.plugin_gui.title: Plugin editor
rack.plugin_gui.text: Opens the plugin's own editor window.

rack.plugin_params.title: Plugin parameters
rack.plugin_params.text: Opens the parameter pane, a list of every parameter of the plugin with search and automation.

rack.plugin_reload.title: Reload plugin
rack.plugin_reload.text: Creates the plugin again from its saved state. Use it after a plugin has crashed. While a plugin is loading the button says SKIP: it stops the load, keeps the saved state and leaves the device a stand-in until you press RELOAD.

rack.plugin_relink.title: Relink plugin
rack.plugin_relink.text: Points this stand-in at another installed plugin when the original is missing.

rack.plugin_mpe.title: Send MPE
rack.plugin_mpe.text: Sends the notes to this plugin as MPE: each note on a channel of its own from 2 to 16, with its pitch, pressure and timbre curves as that channel's pitch bend, pressure and CC 74. Use it for a plugin that takes plain MIDI; plugins that take note expressions already get the curves without it.

rack.plugin_cv.title: CV input
rack.plugin_cv.text: A control voltage input of the plugin. Click it to choose the parameter it drives in the parameter pane.

rack.pattern.title: Pattern controls
rack.pattern.text: The buttons of the pattern row: choose, add, copy, clear and edit the patterns of the player. Double-click the preview to open the step grid.

rack.arpeggio.title: Arpeggio controls
rack.arpeggio.text: The order, rate, octaves and step row of the arpeggiator. Click a step to cycle rest, on, tie and accent.

rack.scale_from_clip.title: Scale from clip
rack.scale_from_clip.text: Copies the scale of the clip that is open in the piano roll into this device.

rack.bypass_inserts.title: Bypass insert effects
rack.bypass_inserts.text: Bypasses every insert effect of this strip at once. It is one undo step, and clicking again brings them all back.

rack.show_inserts.title: Show insert effects
rack.show_inserts.text: Shows or hides the insert effects under this strip. The effects keep working while they are hidden.

help.idle.title: Help Mode
help.idle.text: Point at any control to read about it here. Clicks still work as usual.

arrangement.add_track.title: Add a track
arrangement.add_track.text: Adds a song track for this device, so that the notes of its clips play it. The new track comes with its own lanes.

arrangement.add_audio.title: Add an audio track
arrangement.add_audio.text: Adds a track for audio clips. Drop an audio file on it, or arm it and record from an audio input.

status.load.title: Engine load
status.load.text: The share of the time for each audio block that the engine uses, with its peak and the devices that use the most. When it nears 100 % the sound can drop out; freezing a heavy track lowers it.

modal.close.title: Close
modal.close.text: Closes the panel and goes back to the song. Nothing in the song changes unless the panel said it would.

modal.cancel.title: Cancel
modal.cancel.text: Leaves the panel without making the change it was offering. Everything stays as it was.

modal.export.preset.title: Export preset
modal.export.preset.text: Fills in the options of the panel for a purpose: streaming, podcast, video, stems, club, or a preset of your own. You can still change any option afterwards.

modal.export.preset_save.title: Save preset
modal.export.preset_save.text: Keeps the current options as a preset of your own under a name you type. It then shows in the preset list.

modal.export.preset_delete.title: Delete preset
modal.export.preset_delete.text: Deletes the preset shown in the list. Only presets you saved can be deleted, not the built-in ones.

modal.export.name_ok.title: Save under this name
modal.export.name_ok.text: Saves the options as a preset under the name in the field. A name that already exists is replaced.

modal.export.name_cancel.title: Do not save the preset
modal.export.name_cancel.text: Goes back to the options without saving a preset.

modal.export.file.title: File type
modal.export.file.text: Chooses the kind of file to write: WAV, AIFF or FLAC without loss, or MP3, AAC and Opus when FFmpeg is installed. The compressed types are smaller but lossy.

modal.export.depth.title: Bit depth
modal.export.depth.text: Sets the precision of the file: 16-bit like a compact disc, 24-bit, or 32-bit float that keeps the mix untouched. A compressed file ignores it, because the encoder decides.

modal.export.dither.title: Dither
modal.export.dither.text: Adds a little noise before rounding to 16 bits so quiet detail does not turn into distortion. Triangular is the usual choice; Shaped moves the noise towards the high frequencies.

modal.export.rate.title: Sample rate
modal.export.rate.text: Writes the file at the sample rate of the project, or converts the render to the rate you pick.

modal.export.quality.title: Quality
modal.export.quality.text: Sets how a compressed file is encoded: a variable bitrate that follows the music, or a constant bitrate in kilobits per second. Higher is clearer and bigger.

modal.export.tail.title: Tail
modal.export.tail.text: Keeps what still rings out after the End marker, such as a reverb or a delay, while it is audible. Turn it off to cut the file exactly at the End marker.

modal.export.dry.title: Stem source
modal.export.dry.text: Writes each stem as it sounds in the mix, with fader, pan and inserts, or as the dry source before its strip. Buses, returns and the master are left out of the dry stems.

modal.export.range.title: Range
modal.export.range.text: Chooses what to render: the whole song from the start to the End marker, only the range between the locators, or the time range selected on the lanes.

modal.export.mono.title: Channels
modal.export.mono.text: Keeps the channels of the project's output, or mixes every channel into one before the file is written.

modal.export.ceiling.title: Ceiling
modal.export.ceiling.text: The true-peak ceiling the limiter keeps the export under when a loudness target is set: -1 dBTP, -2 dBTP or a value you type.

modal.export.custom_ceiling.title: Custom ceiling
modal.export.custom_ceiling.text: Type a true-peak ceiling from -9.0 to 0.0 dBTP. Enter keeps it, Esc leaves the one before.

modal.export.custom_lufs.title: Custom loudness
modal.export.custom_lufs.text: Type a loudness target from -40.0 to -5.0 LUFS (a number without a sign is read as negative). Enter keeps it, Esc leaves the one before.

modal.export.loudness.title: Loudness
modal.export.loudness.text: Leaves the level as the song has it, brings it to a loudness target with a limiter that keeps the peaks under -1 dBTP, or only reports the distance to a target without changing anything.

modal.export.stem_gain.title: Stem gain
modal.export.stem_gain.text: Same gain for all gives every stem the one gain that brings the mix to the target, so the stems still add up to the mix (no limiter). Each stem brings every stem to the target on its own, with the limiter.

modal.export.extra.title: Also write an MP3
modal.export.extra.text: Writes an MP3 from the same render next to the main file. It needs FFmpeg.

modal.export.start.title: Export
modal.export.start.text: Renders the song and writes the file, or the files for stems. You can follow the progress and stop it.

modal.export.cancel.title: Cancel
modal.export.cancel.text: Closes the panel without exporting. While a render runs, it stops the render and writes nothing.

modal.film.cover.title: Film range
modal.film.cover.text: Chooses what the film covers: only the part of the song under the film, after its trim and start, or the whole song with black pictures where the film is not playing.

modal.film.picture.title: Film picture
modal.film.picture.text: Copies the picture untouched, which is fast but cuts snap to keyframes, or re-encodes it to H.264 so every cut is exact. Auto copies when the cut is at the film's start.

modal.film.quality.title: Picture quality
modal.film.quality.text: Sets the quality of the H.264 picture: high for a big file that looks like the source, standard for a moderate size, or small for a softer picture. It is not used while the picture is copied.

modal.film.sound.title: Sound
modal.film.sound.text: Writes the mix as AAC in an MP4 file, or as 24-bit PCM, untouched, in a MOV file.

modal.film.bitrate.title: AAC bitrate
modal.film.bitrate.text: Sets the AAC bitrate in kilobits per second: higher is clearer and bigger. It is not used for PCM sound.

modal.film.own_audio.title: Keep the film's sound
modal.film.own_audio.text: Keeps the film's own sound as a second audio track after the mix. It is not available when the film has no sound.

modal.film.start.title: Export film
modal.film.start.text: Renders the mix and writes the film. It needs FFmpeg.

modal.film.cancel.title: Cancel
modal.film.cancel.text: Closes the panel without exporting. While the job runs, it stops the job and writes nothing.

modal.song_info.apply.title: Apply
modal.song_info.apply.text: Makes the texts of the panel the song information: title, artist, notes and the rest. It is one undo step.

modal.versions.save.title: Save version
modal.versions.save.text: Keeps the song as it is now under the name you type. A named version is never pruned. While a version is being renamed, it gives the version that name instead.

modal.versions.rename.title: Rename
modal.versions.rename.text: Changes the name of the chosen version. An empty name clears it.

modal.versions.delete.title: Delete
modal.versions.delete.text: Deletes the chosen version for good. A protected automatic version must be unprotected first.

modal.versions.restore.title: Restore
modal.versions.restore.text: Opens the chosen version as the song. The song as it is now is kept as a version first, so nothing is lost. While a deletion is being confirmed, it confirms it.

modal.versions.protect.title: Protect
modal.versions.protect.text: Protects an automatic version so that pruning never removes it. While a deletion is being confirmed, it keeps the version instead.

modal.versions.compare.title: Compare
modal.versions.compare.text: Lists what differs between the chosen version and the song now: tracks, devices, clips, tempo, meter, length and mixer strips. Shift-click marks a second version to compare with.

modal.versions.back.title: Back
modal.versions.back.text: Goes back from the comparison to the list of versions.

modal.backup.restore.title: Open copy
modal.backup.restore.text: Opens the chosen backup copy as a new song. The copy itself is never changed.

modal.share.share.title: Share
modal.share.share.text: Chooses a file and writes the project, its audio and the credits into it, ready to send.

modal.share.box.title: Share options
modal.share.box.text: Adds a listening copy at -14 LUFS, one WAV file for each mixer strip, or the list of plugins the song uses to the share. Stems make the share bigger.

modal.relink.search.title: Search a folder
modal.relink.search.text: Searches a folder for the missing files and relinks what it finds in one undo step.

modal.relink.project.title: Choose the project folder
modal.relink.project.text: Picks the folder of the original project, the one with its Audio folder, to get its files back.

modal.relink.locate.title: Locate
modal.relink.locate.text: Chooses the file that replaces this missing audio. All the clips that used it are relinked.

modal.history.row.title: Undo history step
modal.history.row.text: A step of the song's history. Click it to go back or forward to the song as it was after this step; the step you are on is highlighted.

modal.command_palette.row.title: Unavailable command
modal.command_palette.row.text: A command that cannot run right now. Running it tells you why.

modal.param_search.reveal.title: Show in the rack
modal.param_search.reveal.text: Shows the selected parameter in the rack, on the device that holds it.

modal.param_search.lane.title: Show automation
modal.param_search.lane.text: Shows the automation lane of the selected parameter in the arrangement, and makes it if the track has none.

modal.param_search.macro_assign.title: Assign to a macro
modal.param_search.macro_assign.text: Drives the selected parameter from a macro, with a range you can set in the Macros panel.

modal.param_search.learn.title: Learn
modal.param_search.learn.text: Waits for you to move a knob or press a key on a controller and maps the selected parameter to it.

modal.param_search.value_cell.title: Parameter value
modal.param_search.value_cell.text: Shows the current value of the parameter. Scroll over it to change it; hold Shift for fine steps.

modal.macros.new_bank.title: New bank
modal.macros.new_bank.text: Starts a new bank of eight macros.

modal.macros.bank.title: Macro bank
modal.macros.bank.text: Shows this bank of eight macros.

modal.macros.name.title: Macro name
modal.macros.name.text: The name of the macro. Click it to rename the macro.

modal.macros.bar.title: Macro value
modal.macros.bar.text: The value of the macro. Click to set it; every parameter assigned to the macro follows.

modal.macros.learn.title: Learn
modal.macros.learn.text: Waits for you to move a knob or press a key on a controller and maps the macro to it.

modal.macros.clear.title: Clear the macro
modal.macros.clear.text: Removes every parameter this macro drives.

modal.macros.target.title: Target parameter
modal.macros.target.text: The parameter the macro drives. Click to show it in the rack.

modal.macros.min.title: Value at minimum
modal.macros.min.text: The value of the parameter when the macro is at its minimum. Drag it, click to raise it, right-click to lower it, or middle-click to type a value.

modal.macros.max.title: Value at maximum
modal.macros.max.text: The value of the parameter when the macro is at its maximum. Drag it, click to raise it, right-click to lower it, or middle-click to type a value.

modal.macros.curve.title: Curve
modal.macros.curve.text: The shape of the travel between the two values: linear, exponential with a slow start, or logarithmic with a fast start.

modal.macros.smooth.title: Smoothing
modal.macros.smooth.text: The glide time of a live move of the macro. Click for a longer time, right-click or use the wheel to step.

modal.macros.invert.title: Invert direction
modal.macros.invert.text: Reverses the direction of the parameter, so it falls while the macro rises.

modal.macros.remove.title: Remove
modal.macros.remove.text: Stops the macro driving this parameter.

modal.mod_matrix.picker.title: Source and target
modal.mod_matrix.picker.text: Chooses what moves what: the source of the device, the parameter it moves, or a second source that scales the amount.

modal.mod_matrix.amount.title: Amount
modal.mod_matrix.amount.text: How far the source moves the target, from -100 to +100 percent. Right-click sets it to zero.

modal.mod_matrix.clear.title: Clear slot
modal.mod_matrix.clear.text: Clears this slot of the matrix.

modal.midi_maps.clear.title: Clear all
modal.midi_maps.clear.text: Removes every MIDI mapping of the project.

modal.midi_maps.import.title: Import
modal.midi_maps.import.text: Applies a mapping preset file to this project.

modal.midi_maps.export.title: Export
modal.midi_maps.export.text: Saves these mappings as a preset file.

modal.midi_maps.export_device.title: Export for a device
modal.midi_maps.export_device.text: Saves the mappings of the selected device as a preset that fits any device of its type.

modal.midi_maps.port.title: Input port
modal.midi_maps.port.text: The input port the control must come from. Click for the next port, right-click for the previous one.

modal.midi_maps.channel.title: MIDI channel
modal.midi_maps.channel.text: The MIDI channel the control must be on. Click for the next channel, right-click for the previous one.

modal.midi_maps.learn.title: Learn
modal.midi_maps.learn.text: Waits for you to move a knob or press a key and uses it as the new source of this control.

modal.midi_maps.consume.title: Consume
modal.midi_maps.consume.text: When on, the message is not passed on to other mappings.

modal.midi_maps.pickup.title: Pickup
modal.midi_maps.pickup.text: When on, the control waits until the source passes its current value, so it does not jump.

modal.midi_maps.invert.title: Invert direction
modal.midi_maps.invert.text: Reverses the direction of the control.

modal.midi_maps.mode.title: Mode
modal.midi_maps.mode.text: How the source is read: absolute, or one of the relative encoder modes. Click for the next mode, right-click for the previous one.

modal.midi_maps.max.title: Highest value
modal.midi_maps.max.text: The highest value the control reaches. Click to raise it, right-click to lower it.

modal.midi_maps.min.title: Lowest value
modal.midi_maps.min.text: The lowest value the control reaches. Click to raise it, right-click to lower it.

modal.bass_read.measure.title: Measure the bass
modal.bass_read.measure.text: Renders the chosen strip and reads how much of its bass a small speaker keeps. While it runs, the same button stops the measurement.

modal.bass_read.list.title: Strip to read
modal.bass_read.list.text: Chooses the master or a track. The meter reads the strip as it sounds in the mix.

modal.bass_read.meter.title: Bass kept
modal.bass_read.meter.text: Shows how much of the energy of the bass note a small speaker plays through its harmonics. A low figure means the bass vanishes on a small speaker.

modal.blind.again.title: Run again
modal.blind.again.text: Runs the test again with the two sounds in a new order.

modal.blind.listen.title: Listen
modal.blind.listen.text: Plays one of the two sounds without saying which it is.

modal.blind.pick.title: Choose this sound
modal.blind.pick.text: Chooses this sound for the trial. Hear both first.

modal.blind.match.title: Match level
modal.blind.match.text: Levels both sounds to the same loudness, so the test is about the sound and not the volume.

modal.chords.replace.title: Replace
modal.chords.replace.text: Puts these chords in the chord lane over the span, replacing the chords it has there. It is one undo step.

modal.chords.merge.title: Merge
modal.chords.merge.text: Puts these chords in the lane only where it has none. It is one undo step.

modal.chords.key.title: Set the key too
modal.chords.key.text: Also sets the song key the audio points to, in the same undo step.

modal.chords.strip.title: Chords found
modal.chords.strip.text: The chords found in the audio. A dimmed chord is a less sure guess.

modal.color_picker.apply.title: Use this colour
modal.color_picker.apply.text: Uses the colour you picked. It is one undo step.

modal.color_picker.square.title: Saturation and brightness
modal.color_picker.square.text: Picks the saturation across and the brightness down for the hue chosen on the strip.

modal.color_picker.strip.title: Hue
modal.color_picker.strip.text: Picks the hue of the colour.

modal.color_picker.swatches.title: Colours of the menu
modal.color_picker.swatches.text: The colours of the colour menu. Click one to use it as it is.

modal.delivery.tab.title: Delivery page
modal.delivery.tab.text: Switches between the loudness targets of the master and the trimming of the shortest peaks of an audio clip.

modal.delivery.main.title: Measure or dip
modal.delivery.main.text: On the targets page it renders the master and measures its loudness and true peak, and the same button stops the measurement. On the peaks page it dips the chosen peak by one step.

modal.delivery.action.title: Apply
modal.delivery.action.text: On the targets page it sets the master limiter's ceiling and the target of the export report. On the peaks page it dips every peak above the threshold.

modal.delivery.list.title: Targets and peaks
modal.delivery.list.text: On the targets page, choose a target to see the gain it would apply to the measured master. On the peaks page, the list shows the highest peaks of the clip and the headroom you get by trimming down to each.

modal.delivery.row.title: Target verdict
modal.delivery.row.text: What this target would do to the master: the gain it would apply and what that means for the peaks.

modal.delivery.threshold_down.title: Threshold
modal.delivery.threshold_down.text: Moves the peak threshold in small steps. Peaks above it are the ones that get dipped.

modal.delivery.step.title: Dip size
modal.delivery.step.text: How much one dip takes off a peak: a few tenths of a decibel.

modal.delivery.width.title: Dip width
modal.delivery.width.text: How many samples each side of a peak a dip spreads over. It is only a few samples, so the change is not heard.

modal.delivery.rescan.title: Read again
modal.delivery.rescan.text: Reads the selected audio clip again to list its peaks.

modal.kick_bass.pick.title: Kick and bass tracks
modal.kick_bass.pick.text: Picks the track that plays the kick drum and the track that plays the sub bass. The check compares the two.

modal.kick_bass.run.title: Check the tracks
modal.kick_bass.run.text: Renders the two tracks and checks how they sit together. While it runs, the same button stops the check.

modal.kick_bass.apply.title: Apply the change
modal.kick_bass.apply.text: Makes the suggested change to the song, such as a duck from the kick. It is one undo step.

modal.masking.analyse.title: Analyse
modal.masking.analyse.text: Renders the channels and ranks where two of them fight for the same frequencies. While it runs, the same button stops the analysis.

modal.masking.demask.title: De-mask
modal.masking.demask.text: Keys a Dynamic EQ band on the covered track from the other track, so it gives way only when needed. It is one undo step.

modal.masking.chart.title: Clash chart
modal.masking.chart.text: Shows where the tracks clash: shaded bands are the clashes. Click a band to de-mask it, or click a clash in the list to move the playhead to its start.

modal.mixcheck.run.title: Check the mix
modal.mixcheck.run.text: Renders the song and lists what the mix check finds. While it runs, the same button stops the check.

modal.mixcheck.fix.title: Apply the fix
modal.mixcheck.fix.text: Applies the fix for the chosen finding. It is one undo step.

modal.mixcheck.tool.title: Open the tool
modal.mixcheck.tool.text: Opens the tool that works on the chosen finding, so you can fix it by hand.

modal.mixcheck.list.title: Findings
modal.mixcheck.list.text: The findings of the check. Click one to choose it; a finding with a time also moves the playhead there.

modal.repetition.find.title: Find again
modal.repetition.find.text: Searches the song again for ideas that repeat three times or more without a change.

modal.repetition.list.title: Repeated ideas
modal.repetition.list.text: The ideas that repeat. Click one to choose it and move the playhead to where it starts.

modal.repetition.choice.title: Variation
modal.repetition.choice.text: Makes a variation of the repeated idea, in one undo step. Some entries are only advice: click them to read the advice below.

modal.reverb_send.add.title: Add
modal.reverb_send.add.text: Adds the send, the return, the EQ and the reverb in one undo step.

modal.sound_analyst.open.title: Open a file
modal.sound_analyst.open.text: Picks an audio file to analyse, or you can drop one on the panel. While it analyses, the same button stops it.

modal.sound_analyst.match.title: Compare
modal.sound_analyst.match.text: Renders the patch as it is now on the same note and compares its curves with those of the file.

modal.sound_analyst.make.title: Make the patch
modal.sound_analyst.make.text: Adds the proposed patch on a new track. It is one undo step.

modal.sound_analyst.curve.title: Analysis curve
modal.sound_analyst.curve.text: A curve measured on the file: the loudness over time, the brightness over time, or the pitch over time.

modal.zone.listen.title: Listen
modal.zone.listen.text: Switches between the mix and the selected reference, level matched, so you can compare them by ear.

modal.zone.refresh.title: Measure again
modal.zone.refresh.text: Renders the mix again and measures it against the references.

modal.zone.match.title: Match section
modal.zone.match.text: Matches the reference to the mix over the time selection or the loop. While it runs, the same button stops measuring.

modal.zone.ref.title: Reference
modal.zone.ref.text: Selects this reference track to compare with the mix.

modal.zone.trim.title: Reference trim
modal.zone.trim.text: Raises or lowers the level of the reference in small steps, or takes its trim back to zero.

modal.quantize.apply.title: Quantize
modal.quantize.apply.text: Quantizes the selection with these settings. It is one undo step.

modal.quantize.live.title: Live groove
modal.quantize.live.text: Plays the selected clips with the chosen groove at the strength above. Their notes are not changed.

modal.quantize.clear_live.title: Clear live groove
modal.quantize.clear_live.text: Gives the selected clips back to the groove of their track.

modal.quantize.rename.title: Rename groove
modal.quantize.rename.text: Renames the chosen groove of this song. Enter does it too.

modal.quantize.name.title: Groove name
modal.quantize.name.text: The name of the chosen groove of this song. Type a new name to change it.

modal.quantize.extract.title: Extract groove
modal.quantize.extract.text: Measures the feel of the selected clip and keeps it as a new groove.

modal.quantize.midi.title: Groove from a file
modal.quantize.midi.text: Measures the feel of a MIDI file as a new groove. Dropping a MIDI file on the panel does the same.

modal.quantize.delete.title: Delete groove
modal.quantize.delete.text: Deletes this groove from the song.

modal.scale.apply.title: Scale
modal.scale.apply.text: Scales the selected clips to this tempo. It is one undo step.

modal.silence.apply.title: Strip silence
modal.silence.apply.text: Cuts the silences out of the selected clips with these settings. It is one undo step.

modal.warp.apply.title: Apply
modal.warp.apply.text: Applies these warp settings to the selected clips. It is one undo step.

modal.warp.detect.title: Detect tempo
modal.warp.detect.text: Estimates the source tempo from the transients of the clip.

modal.warp.reset.title: Unstretched tempo
modal.warp.reset.text: Turns warp off and clears the markers, so the clip plays its audio as it is. It is one undo step.

modal.warp.factor.title: Halve or double
modal.warp.factor.text: Halves or doubles the source tempo, when the detection found half or twice the real tempo.

modal.notes.apply.title: Extract notes
modal.notes.apply.text: Turns the selected audio clips into notes, one undo step each. While it runs, the same button stops it and the notes already added stay.

modal.harmony_picker.apply.title: Set chord or key
modal.harmony_picker.apply.text: Sets the chord, key change or song key you typed. It is one undo step.

modal.harmony_picker.field.title: Chord
modal.harmony_picker.field.text: Type a chord such as Am7, F#m7b5, C/G, Bbmaj7 or Dsus4.

modal.harmony_picker.fill_root.title: Fill root
modal.harmony_picker.fill_root.text: The root the scale buttons fill the notes from.

modal.harmony_picker.fill_scale.title: Fill with a scale
modal.harmony_picker.fill_scale.text: Fills the notes with this scale on the fill root. You can still turn single notes on or off after.

modal.harmony_picker.remove.title: Remove
modal.harmony_picker.remove.text: Takes the song key away, or deletes the key change or the chord you are editing. It is one undo step.

modal.harmony_picker.scale_name.title: Scale name
modal.harmony_picker.scale_name.text: The name the CV quantizers list this song scale by. Renaming it keeps every quantizer that uses it.

modal.harmony_picker.scale_notes.title: Scale notes
modal.harmony_picker.scale_notes.text: Turns this note of the scale on or off. Every quantizer that uses the scale follows.

modal.stems.stem.title: Stem to make
modal.stems.stem.text: Check the stems you want. Each checked stem becomes a track of its own.

modal.stems.mute.title: Mute the source clip
modal.stems.mute.text: Mutes the clip that was separated, so that only the stems play.

modal.stems.separate.title: Separate the stems
modal.stems.separate.text: Makes a track for each stem that is checked.

modal.stems.cancel.title: Cancel the separation
modal.stems.cancel.text: Closes the dialog, or stops the separation that is running.

modal.camera.download.title: Download
modal.camera.download.text: Downloads the two model files once and turns the camera control on.

modal.camera.cancel.title: Do not download
modal.camera.cancel.text: Closes the dialog without downloading anything.

modal.camera.bounds.title: Camera preview
modal.camera.bounds.text: Shows what the camera sees, with the frame rate and the time the models take for each frame.

modal.video.size.title: Picture size
modal.video.size.text: Chooses how large the film picture is shown.

modal.video.timecode.title: Timecode
modal.video.timecode.text: Shows the timecode of the picture over it.

modal.video.frame_number.title: Frame number
modal.video.frame_number.text: Shows the frame number of the picture over it.

modal.plugin_manager.search.title: Search
modal.plugin_manager.search.text: Finds plugins by name, vendor, path or tag.

modal.plugin_manager.format.title: Format filter
modal.plugin_manager.format.text: Shows only VST3 or only CLAP plugins. Click to step through the choices.

modal.plugin_manager.status.title: Status filter
modal.plugin_manager.status.text: Shows the plugins of one status, such as working, failed or disabled. Click to step through them.

modal.plugin_manager.category.title: Category filter
modal.plugin_manager.category.text: Shows the plugins of one category. Click to step through the categories.

modal.plugin_manager.tag_filter.title: Tag filter
modal.plugin_manager.tag_filter.text: Shows the plugins that carry one tag. Click to step through the tags.

modal.plugin_manager.add_tag.title: Add tag
modal.plugin_manager.add_tag.text: Tags the chosen plugins with the text in the field.

modal.plugin_manager.disable.title: Disable plugins
modal.plugin_manager.disable.text: Hides the chosen plugins from the browser. Projects that use them still load.

modal.plugin_manager.try_again.title: Try again
modal.plugin_manager.try_again.text: Takes the quarantined plugins out of quarantine and scans the failed files again.

modal.plugin_manager.folder.title: Show the file
modal.plugin_manager.folder.text: Opens the file manager at the file of the chosen plugin.

modal.plugin_manager.rescan_selected.title: Scan again
modal.plugin_manager.rescan_selected.text: Scans the files of the chosen plugins again.

modal.plugin_manager.no_limit.title: Scan with no time limit
modal.plugin_manager.no_limit.text: Scans the file again with no time limit, so a slow plugin gets as long as it needs. Cancel stops it.

modal.plugin_manager.rescan_all.title: Scan all
modal.plugin_manager.rescan_all.text: Scans every plugin folder again. While a scan runs, the same button stops it.

modal.plugin_manager.tag_chip.title: Tag
modal.plugin_manager.tag_chip.text: A tag of the plugin. Click it to take the tag off.

modal.plugin_manager.column.title: List column
modal.plugin_manager.column.text: Sorts the list by this column. Click again to reverse the order. The star column puts the favourites first.

modal.plugin_manager.status_cell.title: Plugin status
modal.plugin_manager.status_cell.text: The status of the plugin. Point at it to read why a plugin did not load.

modal.plugin_manager.process_cell.title: Plugin process
modal.plugin_manager.process_cell.text: Where the plugin runs: the default from Settings, its own process, or a process shared with others. Click to step through the choices.

modal.plugin_manager.star_cell.title: Favourite
modal.plugin_manager.star_cell.text: Marks the plugin as a favourite. Favourites are listed first in the browser.

modal.plugin_settings.enable.title: Third-party plugins
modal.plugin_settings.enable.text: Turns third-party plugins on or off. When off, no plugin is scanned or loaded.

modal.plugin_settings.editors.title: Editors
modal.plugin_settings.editors.text: Chooses where plugin editors open: each in a window of its own, or inside the Atomik window where the system allows it.

modal.plugin_settings.sandbox_toggle.title: Sandbox
modal.plugin_settings.sandbox_toggle.text: Runs each plugin in its own process, so a crash cannot take Atomik down.

modal.plugin_settings.process_button.title: Process sharing
modal.plugin_settings.process_button.text: Chooses how plugins share processes. When they share one, a crash stops every plugin in it.

modal.plugin_settings.add_folder.title: Add folder
modal.plugin_settings.add_folder.text: Adds a folder to search for plugins.

modal.plugin_settings.folder_remove.title: Remove folder
modal.plugin_settings.folder_remove.text: Removes this folder from the places searched for plugins.

modal.plugin_settings.scan.title: Scan
modal.plugin_settings.scan.text: Scans the folders for new and changed plugins.

modal.plugin_settings.full_rescan.title: Scan all again
modal.plugin_settings.full_rescan.text: Scans every plugin again, even the ones that were scanned before.

modal.plugin_settings.rescan_failed.title: Retry failed
modal.plugin_settings.rescan_failed.text: Tries the files that failed again.

modal.plugin_settings.timeout_dec.title: Shorter time
modal.plugin_settings.timeout_dec.text: Allows less time per plugin during a scan.

modal.plugin_settings.timeout_inc.title: Longer time
modal.plugin_settings.timeout_inc.text: Allows more time per plugin during a scan.

modal.plugin_settings.cancel_scan.title: Stop the scan
modal.plugin_settings.cancel_scan.text: Stops the scan that is running.

modal.plugin_settings.crash_retry.title: Use again
modal.plugin_settings.crash_retry.text: Uses this plugin again after it crashed.

modal.plugin_settings.plugin_toggle.title: Disable plugin
modal.plugin_settings.plugin_toggle.text: Disables this plugin: it stays installed but is not offered.

modal.plugin_settings.retry_no_limit.title: No time limit
modal.plugin_settings.retry_no_limit.text: Scans the file again with no time limit, so a slow plugin gets as long as it needs.

modal.plugin_learn.automation.title: Learn automation
modal.plugin_learn.automation.text: Touch a control in the plugin and its automation lane is shown in the arrangement.

modal.plugin_learn.midi.title: Learn MIDI
modal.plugin_learn.midi.text: Touch a control in the plugin, then move a hardware control to map it.

modal.plugin_learn.dock.title: Dock the editor
modal.plugin_learn.dock.text: Moves the plugin editor into the Atomik window, or out into a window of its own.

modal.plugin_learn.shut.title: Close the editor
modal.plugin_learn.shut.text: Closes the plugin editor. The plugin keeps playing.

modal.plugin_params.dec.title: Previous value
modal.plugin_params.dec.text: Steps the parameter to its previous value.

modal.plugin_params.inc.title: Next value
modal.plugin_params.inc.text: Steps the parameter to its next value.

modal.plugin_params.toggle.title: Parameter switch
modal.plugin_params.toggle.text: Switches this parameter on or off.

modal.plugin_params.pin.title: Pin parameter
modal.plugin_params.pin.text: Pins this parameter to the device panel in the rack.

modal.plugin_params.auto.title: Parameter automation
modal.plugin_params.auto.text: Shows the automation lane of this parameter in the arrangement.

modal.plugin_params.map.title: Macro assignment
modal.plugin_params.map.text: Drives this parameter from a macro.

modal.plugin_params.cv.title: CV
modal.plugin_params.cv.text: Drives this parameter from one of the CV inputs of the device.

modal.plugin_params.preset_prev.title: Previous preset
modal.plugin_params.preset_prev.text: Loads the previous preset of the plugin.

modal.plugin_params.preset_next.title: Next preset
modal.plugin_params.preset_next.text: Loads the next preset of the plugin.

modal.plugin_params.preset_name.title: Preset
modal.plugin_params.preset_name.text: Chooses a preset of this plugin from its list.

editor.close.title: Close the editor
editor.close.text: Closes this editor and goes back to the song. Your edits are already in the song and in the undo history.

editor.audio.title.title: Audio file name
editor.audio.title.text: The name of the audio file of the clip. Double-click it to rename the file.

editor.audio.mode.title: Editor mode
editor.audio.mode.text: Chooses what the editor does: Overview looks at the clip and its markers, Slice edits the warp markers, Vocal edits the pitch and timing of notes, and Comp chooses which take plays where.

editor.audio.stretch.title: Stretch markers
editor.audio.stretch.text: Dragging a warp marker stretches the audio around it, so the sound before and after it changes speed.

editor.audio.slide.title: Slide
editor.audio.slide.text: Dragging a warp marker slides it along the audio without changing the sound.

editor.audio.revert.title: Revert markers
editor.audio.revert.text: Removes every warp marker, so the clip plays at its natural speed.

editor.audio.split.title: Split at markers
editor.audio.split.text: Cuts the clip into separate clips at every marker.

editor.audio.to_slicer.title: To slicer
editor.audio.to_slicer.text: Makes a loop slicer that slices the clip at its markers, so each slice can be played from a key.

editor.audio.sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
editor.audio.sensitivity.text: Sets how readily the editor finds transients, or notes in Vocal mode. A higher setting finds more of them, a lower one finds fewer.

editor.audio.add_all.title: Add all transients
editor.audio.add_all.text: Puts a marker on every detected transient.

editor.audio.speaker.title: Speaker tool
editor.audio.speaker.text: Press on the clip to hear it exactly as it is in its file, before any warp or edit, and release to stop.

editor.audio.correct.title: Correct pitch
editor.audio.correct.text: Brings the selected notes to the nearest semitone, or to the nearest note of the scale when Scale is on.

editor.audio.flatten.title: Flatten
editor.audio.flatten.text: Flattens the pitch drift of the selected notes, so each note holds a steadier pitch.

editor.audio.flatten_value.title: Flatten amount
editor.audio.flatten_value.text: How much Flatten straightens the notes. Drag up or down to change it.

editor.audio.reset.title: Reset
editor.audio.reset.text: Removes the edits of the selected notes, or of every note when none is selected.

editor.audio.scale.title: Scale
editor.audio.scale.text: When on, pitch correction goes to the notes of the song key instead of every semitone.

editor.audio.cancel.title: Stop analysing
editor.audio.cancel.text: Stops finding the notes of the clip.

editor.audio.crossfade.title: Crossfade length
editor.audio.crossfade.text: Sets the length of the crossfade at the cuts of the comp: shorter or longer.

editor.audio.flatten_comp.title: Flatten the comp
editor.audio.flatten_comp.text: Renders the comp to one new audio file and replaces the takes with it.

editor.audio.keep_formants.title: Keep formants
editor.audio.keep_formants.text: Keeps the formants of the sound while it is transposed, so a voice does not turn into a cartoon. It is for the Tonal mode.

editor.audio.formant.title: Formant shift
editor.audio.formant.text: Moves the formants down or up in semitones, to change the character of the voice without changing its pitch.

editor.audio.link_stereo.title: Link stereo
editor.audio.link_stereo.text: Keeps the phase between left and right while the clip is stretched. It is for the Tonal mode.

editor.sample.load.title: Load a file
editor.sample.load.text: Loads an audio file as a new zone of the sampler.

editor.sample.loop_mode.title: Loop mode
editor.sample.loop_mode.text: Chooses how the sample loops: not at all, forward between the loop markers, or back and forth between them.

editor.sample.trigger.title: Trigger mode
editor.sample.trigger.text: Gate plays the sample while the key is held. One shot plays it to its end after a key press.

editor.sample.page.title: Zone page
editor.sample.page.text: Switches between the zone fields and the page with group, velocity crossfade, round-robin and the zone envelope and filter.

editor.sample.field.title: Zone field
editor.sample.field.text: A setting of the zone. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.slice.load.title: Load a file to slice
editor.slice.load.text: Loads an audio file to slice.

editor.slice.mode.title: Slice mode
editor.slice.mode.text: Slices at the transients that the sensitivity finds, or on an even grid.

editor.slice.sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
editor.slice.sensitivity.text: How many transients are found. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.slice.division.title: Grid division
editor.slice.division.text: How many slices there are for each beat of the grid.

editor.slice.beats.title: Beats
editor.slice.beats.text: The length of the loop in beats. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.slice.slice.title: Slice the loop
editor.slice.slice.text: Slices the loop and maps the slices to keys, so each slice plays from its own key.

editor.slice.to_track.title: To track
editor.slice.to_track.text: Lays the slices out as notes on a new track, in their original order.

editor.slice.field.title: Slice field
editor.slice.field.text: A setting of the selected slice. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.wavetable.safe.title: Align fundamentals
editor.wavetable.safe.text: Aligns the fundamental of every frame when the table is stored, so a morph keeps its level.

editor.wavetable.add.title: Add a frame
editor.wavetable.add.text: Adds a frame after this one: the blend of this frame and the next.

editor.wavetable.del.title: Delete
editor.wavetable.del.text: Deletes this frame. The last one stays.

editor.wavetable.up.title: Move earlier
editor.wavetable.up.text: Moves this frame earlier in the table.

editor.wavetable.down.title: Move later
editor.wavetable.down.text: Moves this frame later in the table.

editor.wavetable.canvas.title: Draw the frame
editor.wavetable.canvas.text: Draw the wave of the frame: the pointer sets the samples it crosses.

editor.wavetable.level.title: Harmonic levels
editor.wavetable.level.text: The level of each harmonic of this frame. Drag across the bars to change them.

editor.wavetable.phase.title: Harmonic phases
editor.wavetable.phase.text: The phase of each harmonic. A full height is half a cycle either way.

editor.wavetable.norm.title: Normalise
editor.wavetable.norm.text: Scales the frame so it peaks at 1.

editor.wavetable.dc.title: Remove offset
editor.wavetable.dc.text: Takes the offset out of the frame.

editor.wavetable.invert.title: Invert
editor.wavetable.invert.text: Flips the polarity of the frame.

editor.wavetable.reverse.title: Reverse
editor.wavetable.reverse.text: Plays the cycle of the frame backwards.

editor.wavetable.smooth.title: Smooth
editor.wavetable.smooth.text: Rounds off the corners of the frame.

editor.wavetable.all.title: Apply to all
editor.wavetable.all.text: Applies Normalise, Remove offset, Invert, Reverse and Smooth to every frame.

editor.wavetable.cut.title: Cut again
editor.wavetable.cut.text: Cuts the sample again with one cycle per frame, at the length that was found.

editor.wavetable.dedupe.title: Drop copies
editor.wavetable.dedupe.text: Drops silent frames and frames that are near copies of the one before.

editor.wavetable.edge.title: Cycle edge
editor.wavetable.edge.text: Makes the end of each cycle meet its start by cross-fading the overlap.

editor.wavetable.edge_amount.title: Edge overlap
editor.wavetable.edge_amount.text: The overlap of the edge in samples. Click for the next value.

editor.wavetable.use.title: Use in oscillator 1
editor.wavetable.use.text: Makes oscillator 1 play this table. Its table choice becomes imported.

editor.wavetable.frame.title: Table frame
editor.wavetable.frame.text: A key frame of the table. Click it to select it.

editor.seq.pattern_button.title: Pattern tools
editor.seq.pattern_button.text: Adds an empty pattern, adds a copy of the edited one, removes it, copies or pastes it with its curves, or clears its steps.

editor.seq.length_step.title: Length step
editor.seq.length_step.text: Makes the pattern one step shorter or longer.

editor.seq.length.title: Pattern length
editor.seq.length.text: The length of the pattern in steps. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.seq.resolution.title: Resolution
editor.seq.resolution.text: The step length of the pattern.

editor.seq.swing.title: Swing
editor.seq.swing.text: Delays every second step to give the pattern a shuffle. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.step.new_pattern.title: New pattern
editor.step.new_pattern.text: Creates the first pattern of the drum machine.

editor.step.resolution.title: Resolution
editor.step.resolution.text: The step length of the grid.

editor.step.steps.title: Number of steps
editor.step.steps.text: The number of steps in the pattern.

editor.step.swing.title: Swing
editor.step.swing.text: Delays every second step to give the pattern a shuffle. Drag or scroll to change it; double-click to reset it.

editor.step.tool.title: Pattern tool
editor.step.tool.text: Shifts the pattern left or right, makes a random pattern, alters it, or inverts it.

editor.step.level.title: Velocity level
editor.step.level.text: Sets how loud new steps are: soft, medium or hard.

editor.container.tab.title: Tab
editor.container.tab.text: Switches between the keyboard splits and the macros of the container.

editor.container.add.title: Add a split
editor.container.add.text: Adds a note split to the keyboard of the container.

editor.container.target.title: Split target
editor.container.target.text: Chooses the device this split plays.

editor.container.transpose.title: Transpose
editor.container.transpose.text: Transposes this split down or up a semitone. Hold Shift to move an octave.

editor.container.pass.title: Pass-through
editor.container.pass.text: Chooses whether this split passes pitch bend, controller changes or pressure to its device.

editor.container.kind.title: Knob or switch
editor.container.kind.text: Makes this macro a knob or an on/off switch for the parameters it drives.

editor.container.target_delete.title: Remove target
editor.container.target_delete.text: Stops this macro driving the parameter.

editor.container.field.title: Range
editor.container.field.text: The value of the parameter when the macro is at its minimum or at its maximum.

editor.tab.value.title: Note value
editor.tab.value.text: Sets the length of the next typed note, from a whole note to shorter values.

editor.tab.dotted.title: Dotted
editor.tab.dotted.text: Makes the note value dotted, one and a half times longer.

editor.tab.triplet.title: Triplet
editor.tab.triplet.text: Makes the note value a triplet, so three fit in the time of two.

editor.tab.bend_amount.title: Bend amount
editor.tab.bend_amount.text: Sets how far a bend goes, in tones. Click to change it.

editor.tab.instrument.title: Instrument and tuning
editor.tab.instrument.text: Shows the instrument, its tuning and the capo. Click it to change them.

editor.tab.technique.title: Technique
editor.tab.technique.text: Marks the selected notes with a playing technique, or sets it for the next notes you type.

editor.sheet.select.title: Chord sheet
editor.sheet.select.text: Goes to the previous or the next chord sheet of the song.

editor.sheet.delete.title: Delete
editor.sheet.delete.text: Deletes this chord sheet. Undo brings it back.

editor.sheet.edit.title: Edit as text
editor.sheet.edit.text: Edits the sheet as text. The text becomes the sheet when you apply it.

editor.sheet.transpose.title: Transpose
editor.sheet.transpose.text: Shows the chords a semitone lower or higher, or back in the written key. The sheet itself is not changed until you apply the transposition.

editor.sheet.capo.title: Capo
editor.sheet.capo.text: Moves the capo one fret down or up and shows the chord shapes to play with it.

editor.sheet.spelling.title: Sharps or flats
editor.sheet.spelling.text: Cycles the preference for writing the notes with sharps or with flats.

editor.sheet.font.title: Text size
editor.sheet.font.text: Makes the text of the sheet smaller or larger.

editor.sheet.instrument.title: Instrument and tuning
editor.sheet.instrument.text: Chooses the instrument and the tuning the chord diagrams are drawn for.

editor.sheet.apply.title: Apply transposition
editor.sheet.apply.text: Writes the transposition into the sheet itself.

editor.sheet.autoscroll.title: Scroll the sheet
editor.sheet.autoscroll.text: Scrolls the sheet by itself, at the speed shown, or follows the transport.

editor.sheet.text.title: Text editing
editor.sheet.text.text: Applies the text as the sheet, or leaves the sheet as it was.

editor.trainer.instrument.title: Instrument and tuning
editor.trainer.instrument.text: Chooses the instrument, then its tuning, that the chord trainer is played on.

editor.trainer.capo.title: Capo
editor.trainer.capo.text: Moves the capo one fret down or up.

editor.trainer.source.title: Source
editor.trainer.source.text: Chooses where the chords come from: a key, a list you type, or the song.

editor.trainer.key.title: Key of the drill
editor.trainer.key.text: Sets the key of the drill: its tonic, and major or minor.

editor.trainer.sevenths.title: Triads or sevenths
editor.trainer.sevenths.text: Chooses between plain triads and seventh chords.

editor.trainer.list.title: Chord list
editor.trainer.list.text: Opens the list of chords as text. Apply makes the text the list; Cancel leaves it as it was.

editor.trainer.mode.title: Drill mode
editor.trainer.mode.text: Chooses the kind of drill. Click for the next mode.

editor.trainer.order.title: Chord order
editor.trainer.order.text: Chooses the order the chords come in. Click for the next order.

editor.trainer.beats.title: Beats per chord
editor.trainer.beats.text: Sets how many beats each chord lasts.

editor.trainer.tempo.title: Tempo
editor.trainer.tempo.text: Makes the drill slower or faster.

editor.trainer.pair.title: Chord pair
editor.trainer.pair.text: Chooses the first or the second chord of the pair to practise changing between. Click for the next chord.

editor.trainer.start.title: Start
editor.trainer.start.text: Starts the drill, or stops it while it runs.

editor.trainer.skip.title: Skip
editor.trainer.skip.text: Gives up this chord and goes on to the next, in the listen drill.

editor.trainer.input.title: Audio input
editor.trainer.input.text: Chooses the audio input the drill listens to. Click for the next input.

editor.trainer.reset_scores.title: Reset scores
editor.trainer.reset_scores.text: Forgets the best scores of every chord pair.

editor.trainer.voicing.title: Fingering
editor.trainer.voicing.text: Shows the previous or the next fingering of the chord.

editor.fretboard.labels.title: Dot labels
editor.fretboard.labels.text: Chooses what the dots on the neck say: note names, fret numbers or intervals. Click to change.

editor.fretboard.left_handed.title: Left-handed
editor.fretboard.left_handed.text: Mirrors the neck for a left-handed player.

editor.fretboard.voicing.title: Chord fingering
editor.fretboard.voicing.text: Shows the fingering of the chord at the playhead on the neck.

editor.practice.loop.title: Loop selection
editor.practice.loop.text: Loops the bars of the selection, or the bar under the cursor when nothing is selected.

editor.practice.click.title: Metronome
editor.practice.click.text: Plays a click on every beat while the song plays.

editor.practice.count_in.title: Count-in
editor.practice.count_in.text: Sets how many bars of count-in play before playback starts. Click to change it.

editor.practice.speed_chip.title: Speed preset
editor.practice.speed_chip.text: Plays at half speed, three quarters, or full speed. Audio clips are muted unless the speed is 100 percent.

editor.practice.speed_step.title: Speed step
editor.practice.speed_step.text: Makes the practice speed one step slower or faster.

editor.practice.speed.title: Practice speed
editor.practice.speed.text: Sets the practice speed from 25 to 150 percent. Audio clips are muted unless it is 100 percent, and the speed is not saved.

editor.practice.trainer.title: Speed trainer
editor.practice.trainer.text: Raises the speed after clean passes of the loop, up to a target. Its values can be set here.

editor.practice.listen.title: Listen
editor.practice.listen.text: Hears the instrument on the audio input and grades each pass of the loop.

editor.practice.input.title: Listen input
editor.practice.input.text: Chooses the audio input that Listen hears. Click for the next input.

editor.practice.latency.title: Calibrate
editor.practice.latency.text: Play along with the click for a few beats and the offset of your input is measured.

editor.practice.results.title: Practice results
editor.practice.results.text: The accuracy of the passes: the last pass, the latest passes of this session, and the passes at this speed.

editor.practice.clear_results.title: Clear results
editor.practice.clear_results.text: Clears the results of this session.

editor.keys.mode.title: Who plays
editor.keys.mode.text: Chooses who plays the strip: the computer keyboard while the strip has the focus, or only the pointer.

editor.keys.octave.title: Octave
editor.keys.octave.text: Moves the keys of the strip one octave down or up.

editor.keys.velocity.title: Velocity
editor.keys.velocity.text: Lowers or raises the velocity of the typed keys by one step.

editor.keys.sustain.title: Sustain
editor.keys.sustain.text: Keeps released keys sounding, like a sustain pedal. Holding Shift while typing does the same.

editor.keys.hold.title: Hold
editor.keys.hold.text: Latches the keys pressed with the pointer. Press again to release them.

editor.keys.variation.title: Variation
editor.keys.variation.text: Changes each typed velocity a little at random, so repeated notes sound less mechanical.

editor.track_panel.bypass.title: Bypass device
editor.track_panel.bypass.text: Bypasses the device of the track, so the signal passes through it unchanged.

editor.track_panel.move.title: Move
editor.track_panel.move.text: Moves the device up or down the chain.

editor.track_panel.remove.title: Remove
editor.track_panel.remove.text: Takes the device out of the chain.

editor.track_panel.send.title: Send
editor.track_panel.send.text: Switches the send on or off.

editor.track_panel.groove.title: Groove
editor.track_panel.groove.text: Chooses the groove of the track: none, the built-in ones, then those of the song. Click for the next or the previous one.

editor.track_panel.groove_amount.title: Groove amount
editor.track_panel.groove_amount.text: How much of the groove plays. The notes themselves stay as they are.

editor.spectrum_eq.strip.title: Mixer strip
editor.spectrum_eq.strip.text: Shows the previous or the next strip of the mixer.

editor.spectrum_eq.follow.title: Follow
editor.spectrum_eq.follow.text: Shows the strip that is selected in the mixer or in the arrangement.

editor.spectrum_eq.check.title: Band switch
editor.spectrum_eq.check.text: Switches a part of the EQ on or off: the EQ itself, the high-pass, the low-pass, or one of the two bells.

editor.spectrum_eq.point.title: EQ point
editor.spectrum_eq.point.text: Drag it to set the frequency and the gain. Shift keeps one axis, Alt-drag changes Q, and Ctrl-click resets the gain.

roll.ctl_fold.title: Fold the controller lane
roll.ctl_fold.text: Folds the controller lane away and keeps the lane chips, or unfolds it again.

roll.ctl_lane.title: Controller lane
roll.ctl_lane.text: Shows this controller lane under the velocity lane. The arrows of a CC or poly aftertouch chip step the controller number or the key.

roll.ctl_curve.title: Curve of new points
roll.ctl_curve.text: Sets the curve of new points: a ramp or a step. Click to switch.

roll.ctl_thin.title: Thin points
roll.ctl_thin.text: Thins the selected points, or the whole lane, by dropping the points that the line through their neighbours reproduces.

roll.ctl_messages.title: Program and SysEx messages
roll.ctl_messages.text: Shows the program changes and SysEx messages of the clip, or goes back to the controller lanes.

roll.ctl_program.title: Program and bank
roll.ctl_program.text: Sets the program of the selected program change, and the bank select MSB and LSB sent before it. The arrows step the values.

roll.ctl_sysex.title: SysEx
roll.ctl_sysex.text: Adds a SysEx message at the playhead, or deletes every program change and SysEx message of the clip.

roll.note_pitch.title: Note pitch
roll.note_pitch.text: The pitch of the selected notes. Drag or scroll, with Shift for an octave, or double-click to type a name like C#3, a number, or plus or minus semitones.

roll.note_position.title: Note start
roll.note_position.text: Where the note starts in the clip, as bar, beat, sixteenth and tick. Drag or scroll a part, or double-click to type.

roll.note_length.title: Note length
roll.note_length.text: The length of the note in bars, beats, sixteenths and ticks. Drag or scroll a part, or double-click to type.

roll.note_velocity.title: Note velocity
roll.note_velocity.text: The velocity of the selected notes, from 1 to 127. Drag or scroll, or double-click to type. With several notes the change applies to each.

arrangement.clip_position.title: Clip start
arrangement.clip_position.text: Where the clip starts, as bar, beat, sixteenth and tick. Drag or scroll a part, or double-click to type. With several clips the change applies to each.

arrangement.clip_length.title: Clip length
arrangement.clip_length.text: The length of the clip in bars, beats, sixteenths and ticks. Drag or scroll a part, or double-click to type.

arrangement.clip_offset.title: Clip offset
arrangement.clip_offset.text: Where in its content the clip starts. It is for note and automation clips; an audio clip keeps its source offset in its content.

arrangement.clip_loop.title: Clip loop
arrangement.clip_loop.text: The length of the loop that repeats inside the clip. Zero turns the loop off, and an audio clip that plays backwards cannot loop.

arrangement.clip_match.title: Match values
arrangement.clip_match.text: Gives every selected clip the length, loop offset and loop length of the first clip.

arrangement.point_position.title: Point position
arrangement.point_position.text: Where the automation point is in the clip. Drag or scroll a part, or double-click to type.

arrangement.point_value.title: Point value
arrangement.point_value.text: The value of the point in the unit of its parameter. Drag or scroll, or double-click to type. With several points the change applies to each.

transport.insp_name.title: Selected clips
transport.insp_name.text: Says what the inspector edits: the selected audio clips, or the audio track when no clip is selected.

transport.insp_fade.title: Fade
transport.insp_fade.text: The length of the fade, in milliseconds or in ticks. Drag or scroll, or double-click to type; click the unit tag to switch units.

transport.insp_transpose.title: Transpose
transport.insp_transpose.text: Transposes the clip in semitones, with the cents after the point. A clip in the Repitch mode is left alone.

transport.insp_gain.title: Clip gain
transport.insp_gain.text: The gain of the clip in dB. Drag or scroll, with Shift for fine steps, or double-click to type.

transport.insp_reverse.title: Reverse
transport.insp_reverse.text: Plays the clip backwards. A warped clip keeps its warp: the stretched audio plays backwards.

transport.insp_warp.title: Warp
transport.insp_warp.text: Makes the clip follow the song tempo while keeping its pitch. The mode, tempo and markers stay when it is switched off.

transport.insp_tempo.title: Clip tempo
transport.insp_tempo.text: The tempo the audio was recorded at, in BPM. The clip plays faster or slower to follow the song.

transport.rec_gain.title: Input gain
transport.rec_gain.text: The gain of the input in dB, applied to the recording and to the monitor. Drag or scroll, or double-click for 0 dB.

transport.rec_safe.title: Clip safe
transport.rec_safe.text: Limits the recording so it never goes above 0 dBFS. The monitor is not limited.

transport.rec_meter.title: Input level
transport.rec_meter.text: The level of the input after the gain. The lamp lights when it reaches 0 dBFS and stays lit until you click here.
